title: Vertical Atmosphere
statement:
A vertical column of shifting pigment rises and dissolves in slow motion. Dense violet and indigo tones expand before dispersing into suspended forms, creating a continuous atmospheric cycle.

Designed as spatial presence, the work balances structure and air, functioning as an atmospheric architecture of motion rather than a narrative image.
